entries.summary: Alibaba Cloud deployed DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on the Qianwen AI platform, making its API and Token Plan available. This multimodal model supports up to one million tokens, handling text and images for coding, document processing, and agent tasks. By utilizing advanced cache compression, the model reduces high-bandwidth memory requirements to one-quarter and storage needs to one-eighth of previous versions, optimizing long-context and high-frequency applications. The deployment leverages vLLM community support, facilitating efficient integration for developers.
